risks.title: Customer-facing checklist blocks go-lives
risks.description: Without the approved checklist no customer-facing GenAI use case can go live; CRM-01 and SAL-08 are waiting.
risks.mitigation: One more drafting round; CRM-01 dry run as test case.
risks.evidence: Customer Service Copilot (CRM-01) explicitly blocked for go-live.

risks.title: No dedicated governance staff
risks.description: All members are part-time, which the chair names as the main reason drafting is slow.
risks.mitigation: Request for 1 FTE Responsible AI lead going to exec committee.
risks.evidence: The working group has no dedicated staff — everyone is part-time.

risks.title: Unknown AI inside third-party SaaS
risks.description: Embedded AI features in vendor software are not inventoried, so high-risk use under the EU AI Act may go unnoticed.
risks.mitigation: Procurement to add AI questions to vendor onboarding by end November.
risks.evidence: we don't yet have a complete inventory of AI features embedded in third-party SaaS

risks.title: Model monitoring tooling unfunded

risks.evidence: manual monitoring won't scale beyond ~10 production use cases

risks.title: Responsible AI training content late

risks.evidence: we're behind on giving them content (was due 1 Oct)
